title: Reviewing Freight Terms

children:
Review the system created freight terms on the Freight Terms Window. 
 During rating, the freight term is passed to Progistics. 
 The system can also print this information on paperwork.

3rd Party Billing (3rd) 
 - The carrier will obtain payment from someone besides the shipper and 
 the customer. 3rd party billing is often used to accommodate accounts 
 that have one central billing address and multiple ship to locations.

Collect (COL) - The carrier 
 will obtain payment from the customer. The shipper is not responsible 
 for payment.

Duty and Taxes Will Be Billed 
 To the Consignee (DDU) - The person signing for the parcel will 
 then pay the duties and taxes for parcel, instead of the shipper.

Prepaid (PPD) - The shipper 
 will pay the freight charges. The customer is not responsible for payment.

Prepaid & Add (PPA) 
 - The shipper will pay the freight charges and later invoice the customer 
 for it.

Using the System Defined 
 Values Tab

Use 
 the External Rating Symbol Field to indicate the Progistics name 
 for a freight term. The system passes this symbol to Progistics when the 
 system requests a rate.

Shipper 
 Pays Freight? Field: This field determines if the shipper is responsible for paying freight charges, or if the recipient is responsible.

- Select 'Yes' if the shipper is responsible for paying the freight charges. In this case, 
 the system would assign the charges to the warehouse or company 
 sending the product. The system will return the charges as normal if this 
 field is set to 'Yes' (or, if the shipment does not have a freight term 
 specified). Generally, you would select 'Yes' if the freight term is Prepaid 
 or Prepaid and Add. Note that if this is not in a multi-company warehouse, 
 the system will only assign freight charges to the warehouse. For a Bill 
 of Lading, the system will fill the "freight bill to" information 
 from shipment data.

- Select 'No' if the recipient is responsible for paying the freight charges. In this case, 
 the system would assign the charges to the appropriate party defined 
 on the shipment record. The system will suppress the freight charges 
 if this field is set as 'No.' Generally, you would select 'No' if the freight 
 term is Collect or Third Party. For a Bill of Lading, the system will 
 fill the "freight bill to" information from company/warehouse 
 data.

Use 
 the FedEx Express Payment Code Field to indicate the FSMS value 
 that corresponds to the freight term for Express services.

Use 
 the FedEx Ground Payment Code Field to indicate the FSMS value 
 that corresponds to the freight term for Ground services.

Use 
 the FedEx Terms of Sale Field to indicate the FSMS value for the 
 Terms corresponding to the freight term.

Press 
 OK. The system will save your changes.
